rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
conjunction adding to the preceding list
compound with internal sandhi: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) + mūlakaulam (root Kaula)

items.question: What additional attainment constitutes the root Kaula teaching, O fair-faced one?
premises: The verse enumerates an additional set of eight.
The attainment of siddhis is identified as the root Kaula.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight siddhis is presented as belonging to the root Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: The specific eight siddhis are not named in this verse and may be supplied by context.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
